# Test Enhancement Skill

Automates test improvements: coverage, reliability, error handling, and reporting. Use to strengthen your test suite and catch regressions early.

## Example Prompts
- "Enhance tests for game logic."
- "Add coverage for asset manager."
- "Improve error handling in automation scripts."
